Subject: Acme - SOC 2 / Security + Compliance recap and next steps

Hi Samir / Emily,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps:

Pain points & goals (what we heard)
- Need centralized, tamper-evident audit logs for inference requests and admin actions (retention: 2 years).
- Require SOC 2 Type II evidence and pen test summary for vendor risk team review.
- Data retention & deletion controls to support DPA clauses; ability to set customer-specific retention windows.
- Access controls (SAML + SCIM) and key management (KMS/HSM) integration required.

What we discussed / Redwood capabilities
- We can provide our SOC 2 report (attached) and a redacted pen-test summary; we maintain immutable audit logs and per-customer retention settings.
- Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated with customer-managed keys available for regulated workloads.
- DPA: shared a draft (attached) we typically use; happy to push edits into DocuSign.

Agreed next steps
- Marissa (Redwood) to send SOC 2 report, redacted pen-test summary, and DPA draft — by Thu 2027-03-04 EOD. (attachments included)
- Rishi (Redwood Security) to validate audit log retention mechanics and provide a short export sample + field-level inventory — by Fri 2027-03-05.
- Acme to confirm acceptable retention window (you mentioned 24 months) and confirm whether Dedicated/VPC is required for the pilot — Samir / Emily to reply by Mon 2027-03-08.
- Schedule a follow-up technical deep-dive with your security team — propose Tue 2027-03-09 10:00 PT (please confirm).

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2024.pdf (full report)
- PenTest_Summary_ThirdParty_LowRisk.pdf (redacted overview)
- DPA_Draft_Acme_Redacted.docx (standard DPA, editable)

Links:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-5421
- DPA DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/link/dpa-acme-2027

If anything above is off, flag and I’ll update. Looking forward to progressing this with your team.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Security & Compliance

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Confirming retention: our compliance team requires a minimum of 24 months for audit logs; can Redwood guarantee immutable storage for that period and provide a tamper-evident hash chain or equivalent?
- For the pen test vendor: can you confirm the tester and scope (external network vs. application vs. infra)? Our risk team typically accepts third-party pen test summaries from recognized providers.
- DPA: we'll review and push redlines; is there a standard SLA or uptime appendix you can share?

We'll confirm Dedicated vs. Hosted for the pilot after a brief internal sync — Emily will take point and loop in our procurement/security (cc’d). The proposed 3/9 10:00 PT works tentatively for the security deep-dive.

Samir

- Retention / immutability: yes — we retain audit logs in a write-once backed store for configurable windows; default retention is 24 months for enterprise customers. - Pen test: vendor was RedPen Security (external app + infra scope). The redacted summary is attached; full report can be produced under NDA if required.
- SLA: standard appendix attached; for Dedicated we offer a 99.9% uptime SLA by contract — happy to share the exact appendix and uptime credits upon request.

Rishi (cc’d) — can you confirm the sample export format and whether we can include the hash-chain artifact as part of the export package for Acme security review?

Deliverables planned by Thu EOD 3/4:
- SOC2 report (attached)
- Redacted pen test summary (attached)
- DPA draft (attached) + DocuSign link placeholder
- Audit log field inventory (attached)

If you need anything earlier, flag here and I’ll prioritize.

Best,

Hi Samir,

Quick technical note on the audit export:
- Format: CSV or JSON per request. Fields include: timestamp (ISO8601), user_id (pseudonymized on request), request_path, model_id, response_latency_ms, admin_action, ip_address (anonymized on request), hash_chain_token.
- Hash chain: we produce a daily SHA-256 root for each tenant; we can include the per-day proof file with the export package. Integrity verification steps are documented and I can include a short runbook.
- Retention enforcement: configurable via Tenant Settings; we set 24 months by default for enterprise pilots.

If Acme wants structure-level PII redaction or additional fields, tell us which fields and we’ll include in the export sample.

I'll attach a one-page runbook and the export sample in the follow-up email (if you want, I can upload to the shared drive link Marissa provided).

Thanks,
Rishi
